title: Union-Find Operations
problemStatement: You are given N initially disconnected vertices and Q operations. Each operation is either: • UNION u v: Merge the sets containing vertices u and v. • FIND u v: Determine whether u and v belong to the same connected component. Process all operations.
input: • First line contains integers N and Q. • Next Q lines each contain an operation.
output: For every FIND operation, print YES if both vertices belong to the same set; otherwise print NO.
